Page.Title: File input
Page.Subtitle: As Blueprint's FileInput: the name of the file chosen and a Browse button. <FileInput> is declared in src/widgets.xml; the button opens the file dialog of the system (Rfile_dialog_open), or Raven's own.

Demo.Title: Raven's file browser, embedded
Demo.Note: FileBrowser is a widget of Raven: places, folders and files, inside a page.
